response.text:
You need to be at the Ausländerbehörde (Stadt Musterstadt, Musterplatz 1, 2. Obergeschoss, Raum 2.14) on Wed 14 Oct 2026 at 10:30 [item:itm_64wce6sh2rpp].

Bring with you:
- Original passport
- Current enrolment certificate for winter semester 2026/27
- Proof of financial means
- Proof of health insurance
- A biometric photo
- Your rental agreement or landlord confirmation
- The fee — girocard only, cash not accepted (it names an amount in the letter text, so check it there)

This is for your residence permit extension (Aufenthaltserlaubnis), based on the invitation letter from Stadt Musterstadt [doc:doc_d9hwr1mp3bsj].
